# Billing evidence in the complete original customer course

Operation: SCF-HOURLY-WORK-CUSTOMER-BILLING-20261013, continued in the same original receiving case. Hourly product base: PR1797 / b79e3a8b39b5821072f9134f3af75a469af7ecd9. Billing evidence product commit: dfad5a07371f2d9a77355e89f6f92d1bf39f78b5. The exact installed source inventory and guide overlay below define this edition.

This edition carries the complete existing milestone and Buyer expense receiving programme forward in one authenticated private account copy. After those original operations, it opens the native Work ledger and retains explicit internal demonstration terms as an original source. The quantity is an explicitly entered engineering demonstration, never represented as customer-approved real time. It records/submits/accepts that original Work through Operations, then uses the actual customer-billing desk to save the original hourly authority and its contributor/package scopes, USD125.00 rate, EXACT rounding and 0.2000-hour/USD25.00 whole-authority cap.

The browser selects 0.1600 hours/USD20.00. It records an unused preparation and corrected cancellation, then changes the original Work description through native reopen/save/submit/accept commands. Applying the older review must return its specific pre-dispatch source refusal; the operator cancels it and selects the current accepted Work edition. The original apply response is deliberately lost only after the original native response is retained; exact replay must recover the same invoice and commands. The course edits the draft, separately reviews/issues it, credits to 0.1200 hours/USD15.00, replaces to 0.0960 hours/USD12.00 and separately issues the replacement.

Every mutation uses the original Operations or native Receivables APIs and journals. The course creates no payment, allocation, refund, settlement, external invoice send or customer correspondence. Original milestone and expense invoices are protected by complete before/after native detail comparisons; original paid account requests, receipts and allocations remain unchanged. All financial changes happen only in the newly authenticated private receiving copy. The original source ZIP and source-case tree remain frozen and their exact hashes are checked.

The complete Operations export now includes every retained hourly authority revision, original Work/events/source bytes, preparation/cancellation request bodies, all charge histories and native command IDs. A fresh Operations workspace imports that actual UI export, replays the original authority and preparation/cancellation requests, and checks unchanged original IDs/history. The final native backup is authenticated and restored into a second private physical destination; both hourly and existing milestone/expense desks bind to the same original native identity and reopen their linked invoices. Complete linked invoice/credit files are retained even when account-as-of exports exclude a future document.

Reservations and authority caps coordinate copies registered in the same Operations database. Independently restored databases must reconcile their retained histories before parallel new financial dispatch; this course does not imply a distributed lock across installations.

Run the existing receiver with this edition's COMPLETE_SOURCE_RECEIVING.json, all numbered source parts and the original private Buyer Library search input. The receiver validates each whole part, decoded source, Git blob and complete selection, receives the original private archives through their existing authorized route, then executes the whole programme. The public source carrier contains code and frozen original artifact locators/hashes. Original customer/account/Buyer fixture bytes and restore key remain in the private receiving operation.

## Customer billing evidence continuation

The whole original milestone → expense → hourly course below still operates only its authenticated private receiving copy. After those actual records exist, `billing_evidence_course.py` selects the original customer/account and all three source domains, explicitly reviews service-period inclusion, freezes the customer-safe explanation and the actual native documents, replays the identical original save request, exports both audiences and independently receives the internal case. It compares the original billing rows before and after: this continuation makes no draft, issue, credit, void, payment or settlement command.

`course/browser-evidence.cjs` then uses the same served case and authorized browser runtime. It loads the exact saved revision, compares current observations, operates supplemental disclosure controls, invalidates and renews the preview, saves a successor, deliberately loses only the observed successful response, and recovers that exact request. It downloads the customer evidence, complete internal evidence, working desk and updated Operations case. The original course uses this final actual Operations ZIP for its existing independent/cold native receiving and opener sequence, so the new evidence revisions travel with the full original case.

Keep the service period distinct from the native account as-of cutoff. Native document balances are observations at the saved native revision and observation time. Source chains carry their full correction history without adding every correction as a new billed amount. Missing, overlapping or outside source dates require an explicit reviewed inclusion reason; no amount is prorated. A historical revision's downloads remain frozen while a successor is reviewed against the current saved head.

The customer ZIP includes the reviewed safe report and unchanged full customer account archive; the account may contain entries outside the selected explanation. Description/quantity controls affect only supplemental source explanation. Issued invoices and credits retain their original customer-facing lines. Private source journals, costs, rates and authority/reviewer notes remain in the internal case.

The browser reopens both downloaded ZIPs through the original inspection route. The full customer ZIP is then safely extracted with every original relative path preserved, including report.html, report.csv, report.json, native-customer-account.tar, manifests and actual invoice/credit HTML. It follows the report's real links and renders every retained native HTML page at desktop and 390 px; no flattened substitute document is used. The complete-archive limit is 64 MiB / 1,600 members. Browser JSON transport remains 32 MiB including base64, so larger bundles use the existing CLI inspection route rather than an incomplete upload.

Read the complete application operating guide at `source/stellar/scf_2026/sf47_budget_model/workspace/BILLING_EVIDENCE.md`. The UI supports frozen revision downloads, explicit comparison, exact pending-request recovery, known pre-save refusal correction, saved working desks and read-only archive inspection. Use the original receiving owner’s browser and current reservation state; keep the producing course in its authorized runtime.

This source edition is prepared and source-reviewed. It does not establish native execution, successful rendered delivery or producing-agent visual inspection. The existing run must retain its actual receipts and screenshots; the producing agent must personally open and LOOK at the desk, every report/native document and all final attachments, operate the relevant controls, and inspect complete exports/reopened cases before declaring that result complete.

## Complete current source selection

This receiving edition installs 1,654 exact source files (29,134,645 UTF-8 bytes), including all 690 files in its managed Grant declaration and the selected native service/support dependencies. The 21 original parts remain byte-for-byte unchanged with their 1,638-file original inventory. Eleven exact postimage overlays update existing paths; sixteen supplemental files add the Billing evidence leaves and nine existing peer declaration files. The manifest retains the original part authority separately from this installed selection.

The public repository integration separately preserves newer peer host registrations, including Airflow additions observed at b17e3c2713163e43e72a739f7bbce29f267cdfc2. This original billing course intentionally runs the exact dfad5a07371f2d9a77355e89f6f92d1bf39f78b5 billing source selection plus its declared guide overlay: 1,654 files / 690 managed declarations. Newer unrelated repository features are not claimed present in this frozen receiving edition. Its ordered inventory is the source authority. Each file retains its original Git identity, size and SHA-256; the hourly postimages are exactly those merged in PR1797. The retained native dependency additions and their manifests are pinned to 961acf4896be9f64286de44bf9e86dd19f1b1a5d, with the later four declared additions pinned to 0df91b6a18c96fbf944cbaff43b7356a335cb984.

The actual Receivables service opened by this course has 66 static source modules, all included, and no bare third-party import on that static boot path. The course still requires its stated installed Node/Python/Playwright runtime and original Chrome distribution. Optional seller adapters retain their original package manifests and locks where published; their PostgreSQL, gRPC, S3, MySQL, MSSQL, Redis, YAML, x402 and schema-pattern engines are not represented as installed by a source transfer. The optional bank-PDF surface retains its original PDF.js 6.4.299 configuration. This billing course does not activate those separate optional adapters. Browser-served client aliases, generated seller/handler modules and original dynamic runtime selections retain their existing native server/generator behavior.

## Producing-agent observation and usable delivery

The producing peer must open the exact final saved application and LOOK at every retained actual image. Inspect all populated/empty/error/recovery states, authority/rate form, source correction refusal, issue review, credit/replacement, saved desk reopening and both light/dark embedding contexts at desktop and390px. Normally use the controls, open every outgoing attachment and usable ZIP content, and inspect native invoice/credit HTML and any report/PDF pages. Source review, HTTP success, DOM counts, captures or another worker's approval do not substitute for looking at the real product. Repair any contrast, clipping, oversized controls or unusable layout directly, then continue the same operation without broad test sweeps or a new approval queue.

The producer retains complete logs, original request/replies, every source and native financial observation, actual save receipts and original private case on failure. It saves the complete account before the post-package opener course, so a later opener failure remains recoverable without repeating earlier financial mutations. A complete source publication is already available; native and visual completion is reported only from the actual original run.

# Open and continue the corrected billing workspace

This opener receives the complete correction-course ZIP into a new private Linux directory, runs its selected current Grant and native Receivables applications, and saves a complete next ZIP when the operator closes them. The original native backup remains the accounting authority. The opener does not create, issue, credit, collect or allocate an invoice automatically.

Use Python 3.11 or later and Node 22 or later. Browser automation and Playwright are needed for the producing course, but not for this customer opener. Choose ordinary persistent storage with space for the complete input, extracted source/account, restored working account and a new compressed edition. Keep the receiving directory outside every earlier native account/state root. Its parent must already exist.

## Receive a delivered edition

Keep the complete delivered ZIP and its independently supplied SHA-256 together. Replace the example filenames, digest and new destination with the actual delivery values:

~~~sh
python3 course/open-correction-desk.py inspect SCF_Correction_Desk.zip --sha256 ACTUAL_DELIVERED_SHA256
python3 course/open-correction-desk.py --node /absolute/path/to/node restore SCF_Correction_Desk.zip --sha256 ACTUAL_DELIVERED_SHA256 --root /absolute/private/correction-workspace
python3 course/open-correction-desk.py --node /absolute/path/to/node open /absolute/private/correction-workspace
~~~

The global --node argument belongs before the command. The restore command creates the named root with mode 0700; it must not exist already. It checks every ZIP member and CRC, safe member paths, the actual runtime selection and each selected file's byte, SHA-256 and Git identity. It then calls the existing authenticated native restore engine with the retained original identity pair and copies the whole primary planning work tree. It never substitutes the optional secondary independent receiving case for the original primary case.

The transport key stays in package/original-account/private/restore-key.txt. It is passed privately to the native recovery child through its environment, never printed. The account archive and key are co-delivered, so treat the whole folder and ZIP as private account material; co-delivery does not provide confidentiality from someone holding the package.

A failed first receiving leaves its partial root and logs intact. That directory is not marked READY. Retain it for diagnosis and receive the unchanged delivered ZIP into another new root. A READY installation is reopened with open; it is never overwritten by restore.

## Use the installed workspace

The open command prints the normal private owner link after both services and the same-ID connection are ready. Open that link in the browser. Choose Delivery operations, the retained case and Customer billing; choose the saved Freeform Solutions schedule. Its original changes, request-recovery controls and linked invoices use the current selected application source.

The native account uses the original workspaceId and sourcesSha256. The original adapter records only the new local transport address under each retained endpoint ID. Existing paid invoices, receipts, allocations, correction history and native request IDs are not reset. Any further financial operation is an explicit action in the original application, with its own existing checks.

Keep this terminal/process open while using the application. Private access details are also in private-access.json. They are local capability links and must not be published. A second opener for the same receiving directory is refused by its existing file lease.

## Close, save and reopen

Press Ctrl-C once for an orderly close. The opener independently stops the planning server, closes its workspace, terminates and reaps its native service group, and closes the logs. It then takes an authenticated full native snapshot and writes a new complete ZIP under deliveries/. The printed COMPLETE_PACKAGE_SAVED receipt and last-delivery.json provide its actual path, size and SHA-256.

The saved edition contains the current complete primary planning tree; the new authenticated native backup and private key; every selected runtime source; the original immutable input and original course; earlier backups indexed by manifest; and actual opening, connection and close logs. Each outgoing ZIP is fully inspected before publication. It keeps the same receiving layout, so inspect and restore can receive it into a genuinely different private root.

Reopen the same working directory after a normal close:

~~~sh
python3 course/open-correction-desk.py --node /absolute/path/to/node open /absolute/private/correction-workspace
~~~

This preserves later local edits and the installed native account. For a separate explicit export while all services are closed:

~~~sh
python3 course/open-correction-desk.py --node /absolute/path/to/node export /absolute/private/correction-workspace --output /absolute/private/next-correction-edition.zip
~~~

The output filename must be new. The source selection and logical account identity are checked again before snapshot. If shutdown or snapshot cannot complete, the opener retains the complete working directory and actual error instead of reporting a finished package. Check opening-history.json, opener-logs/ and any last-delivery.json before continuing. An abruptly killed process may not have saved a new ZIP; the last successful ZIP remains its own immutable edition.

## Producing-course acceptance

The producing agent must operate the actual current desk and LOOK at its real desktop and 390 px screenshots, including the actual paid invoice, credited invoice, credit note and replacement invoice. Inspect the exact outgoing ZIP's usable files and reports. Capture meaningful light and dark surrounding-context states with readable labels and controls. Verify the full save → different-root receive → open journey and preserved native request/history identities with the original programme. Source publication or a captured image alone is not visual acceptance.

The opener source is part of that same programme. No additional customer financial command is needed merely to verify reopening. The runtime file count comes from current-source-selection.json; a compatible, explicitly pinned full source supplement can extend it without changing this opener.

def read_bytes(filename, maximum=MAX_BUNDLE):
    path = Path(filename).expanduser().resolve()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        raw = stream.read(maximum + 1)
    if len(raw) > maximum:
        raise Problem("Input exceeds its retained-source bound.", 413, "INPUT_TOO_LARGE")
    return raw


def reconciliation_document(filename, case_id, mode):
    """Receive the complete original input and preserve every pending request field."""
    try:
        document = json.loads(read_bytes(filename, 64 * 1024 * 1024))
    except (UnicodeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise Problem("Use a complete UTF-8 reconciliation input or downloaded desk.", 422, "INVALID_RECONCILIATION_INPUT") from exc
    if not isinstance(document, dict):
        raise Problem("Use the complete reconciliation input object.", 422, "INVALID_RECONCILIATION_INPUT")
    if document.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.sf47-account-reconciliation-desk.v1":
        if document.get("caseId") != case_id:
            raise Problem("Open this reconciliation desk in its original case.", 409, "RECONCILIATION_DESK_CASE_MISMATCH")
        pending = document.get("pending")
        if mode == "resume" or pending is not None:
            if (not isinstance(pending, dict) or pending.get("caseId") != case_id
                    or pending.get("kind") != "account-reconciliation"
                    or not isinstance(pending.get("body"), dict)
                    or not isinstance(pending["body"].get("requestId"), str)
                    or not pending["body"]["requestId"]):
                raise Problem("Retain the complete original pending reconciliation request.", 422, "INVALID_RECONCILIATION_INPUT")
            document = dict(pending["body"])
        else:
            draft = document.get("draft")
            if not isinstance(draft, dict) or not isinstance(draft.get("document"), dict):
                raise Problem("The downloaded desk needs its complete editable reconciliation document.", 422, "INVALID_RECONCILIATION_INPUT")
            document = {"expectedVersion": document.get("caseVersion"),
                        "reconciliationId": draft.get("reconciliationId"),
                        "expectedRevision": draft.get("expectedRevision"), "state": draft.get("state"),
                        "document": draft["document"]}
    elif mode == "resume":
        raise Problem("Resume from the complete original downloaded reconciliation desk.", 422, "INVALID_RECONCILIATION_INPUT")
    if mode == "preview":
        document = {key: value for key, value in document.items()
                    if key not in ("requestId", "actor", "expectedPreviewSha256")}
    return document


def reconciliation_fields(document, args, applying=False):
    body = dict(document)
    supplied = [("expectedVersion", args.expected_version)]
    if applying:
        supplied += [("actor", args.actor), ("requestId", args.request_id),
                     ("expectedPreviewSha256", args.expected_preview_sha256)]
    for key, value in supplied:
        if value is None:
            continue
        if key in body and body[key] is not None and body[key] != value:
            raise Problem("The supplied " + key + " differs from the retained original reconciliation request.",
                          409, "RECONCILIATION_REQUEST_MISMATCH")
        body[key] = value
    return body


def cash_document(filename, case_id, mode):
    """Keep complete original requests while allowing a downloaded desk to resume."""
    try:
        document = json.loads(read_bytes(filename, 64 * 1024 * 1024))
    except (UnicodeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise Problem("Use a complete UTF-8 JSON cash input or downloaded desk.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT") from exc
    if not isinstance(document, dict):
        raise Problem("Use a complete cash input object.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT")
    is_desk = document.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.sf47-cash-desk.v1"
    if is_desk:
        if document.get("caseId") != case_id:
            raise Problem("The cash desk belongs to another original case.", 409, "CASH_DESK_CASE_MISMATCH")
        pending = document.get("pending")
        if mode == "resume" or (mode == "apply" and pending is not None):
            if not isinstance(pending, dict) or pending.get("kind") not in ("command", "correction") or not isinstance(pending.get("body"), dict):
                raise Problem("The desk must contain its complete pending original request.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT")
            body = pending["body"]
            if mode == "apply" and pending["kind"] != "correction":
                raise Problem("Use cash-desk-resume for the retained original cash or source command.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT")
            if pending["kind"] == "command" and body.get("action") not in ("cash.record", "cash.void", "source.add"):
                raise Problem("Resume only the desk's original cash or source action.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT")
            if not isinstance(body.get("requestId"), str) or not body["requestId"]:
                raise Problem("Retain the original pending request ID.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT")
            return pending["kind"], body
        draft = document.get("draft")
        if not isinstance(draft, dict) or draft.get("kind") != "correction":
            raise Problem("The downloaded desk needs its complete editable correction.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT")
        document = {"expectedVersion": draft.get("expectedVersion"), "selection": draft.get("selection"),
                    "originalCashId": draft.get("originalCashId"), "replacement": draft.get("data"),
                    "reason": draft.get("reason", "")}
    elif mode == "resume":
        raise Problem("Resume from a complete downloaded cash desk.", 422, "INVALID_CASH_INPUT")
    if mode == "preview":
        document = {key: value for key, value in document.items()
                    if key not in ("requestId", "actor", "expectedPreviewSha256")}
    return "correction", document


def cash_apply_fields(document, args):
    body = dict(document)
    for key, value in (("actor", args.actor), ("requestId", args.request_id),
                       ("expectedPreviewSha256", args.expected_preview_sha256)):
        if value is None:
            continue
        if key in body and body[key] != value:
            raise Problem("The supplied " + key + " differs from the retained original correction.", 409, "CASH_REQUEST_MISMATCH")
        body[key] = value
    return body


def ledger_document(filename, compile_sources=False):
    original = Path(filename).expanduser().resolve()
    document = ledger_intake._json(read_bytes(original, 64 * 1024 * 1024), decimal_strings=False)
    raw_defaults = {}
    if isinstance(document, dict) and document.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.sf47-ledger-desk.v1":
        raw_defaults = document.get("rawDefaults", {})
        document = document.get("document")
        if not isinstance(raw_defaults, dict):
            raise Problem("The downloaded desk defaults must be an object.", 422, "INVALID_LEDGER_INTAKE")
    if not isinstance(document, dict) or document.get("schema") != ledger_intake.SCHEMA:
        raise Problem("Use a complete ledger-intake document or downloaded browser desk.", 422, "INVALID_LEDGER_INTAKE")
    files = document.get("files")
    if not isinstance(files, list) or not 1 <= len(files) <= ledger_intake.MAX_FILES:
        raise Problem("Select one through twenty original source files.", 422, "INVALID_LEDGER_INTAKE")
    total = 0
    for spec in files:
        if not isinstance(spec, dict):
            raise Problem("Each source file needs its explicit table specification.", 422, "INVALID_LEDGER_INTAKE")
        if "sourceFile" in spec:
            if not compile_sources:
                raise Problem("Compile sourceFile paths with ledger-intake-build before preview or apply.", 422, "INVALID_LEDGER_INTAKE")
            selected = spec.pop("sourceFile")
            if not isinstance(selected, str) or not selected or "\x00" in selected or "contentBase64" in spec:
                raise Problem("Choose one explicit sourceFile path or original contentBase64 for each file.", 422, "INVALID_LEDGER_INTAKE")
            source = Path(selected).expanduser()
            if not source.is_absolute():
                source = original.parent / source
            raw = read_bytes(source, MAX_SOURCE)
            spec.setdefault("filename", source.name)
            spec["contentBase64"] = base64.b64encode(raw).decode()
        if spec.get("id") in raw_defaults:
            selected = raw_defaults[spec["id"]]
            if not isinstance(selected, str):
                raise Problem("Retained table defaults must be JSON text.", 422, "INVALID_LEDGER_INTAKE")
            spec["defaults"] = ledger_intake._json(selected or "{}", decimal_strings=False)
        if compile_sources:
            inspection = ledger_intake.inspect(spec)
            total += inspection["bytes"]
    if total > ledger_intake.MAX_BYTES or len(canonical(document).encode()) > MAX_BUNDLE:
        raise Problem("The complete intake supports twelve MiB of original source bytes.", 413, "LEDGER_INTAKE_LIMIT")
    return document


def publish(filename, raw):
    """Private exact output; an existing destination is never replaced."""
    destination = Path(filename).expanduser().absolute()
    if not destination.parent.is_dir():
        raise Problem("Output directory does not exist.", 422, "OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_MISSING")
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="." + destination.name + ".", dir=destination.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            os.fchmod(stream.fileno(), 0o600)
            stream.write(raw); stream.flush(); os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        try:
            os.link(temporary, destination)
        except FileExistsError as exc:
            raise Problem("Output already exists; select a new filename.", 409, "OUTPUT_EXISTS") from exc
        descriptor = os.open(destination.parent, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0))
        try:
            os.fsync(descriptor)
        finally:
            os.close(descriptor)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)
    return {"path": str(destination), "bytes": len(raw), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}

        try:
            inputs = json.loads(read_bytes(args.inputs, MAX_SOURCE))
        except (UnicodeError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise Problem("Forecast input must be a UTF-8 JSON object.", 422, "INVALID_JSON") from exc
        if action == "forecast-preview":
            result = ops.preview_forecast(args.case, {"expectedVersion": args.expected_version, "inputs": inputs})
        else:
            result = ops.command(args.case, {"expectedVersion": args.expected_version, "actor": args.actor,
                "requestId": args.request_id, "note": args.note, "action": "forecast.save",
                "data": {"inputs": inputs, "expectedPreviewSha256": args.expected_preview_sha256}})
    elif action == "portfolio-seed":
        body = {"expectedVersion": args.expected_version, "forecastId": args.forecast}
        for filename, field, expected_type in (
            (args.installation_selections, "installationSelections", list),
            (args.inputs, "inputs", dict),
        ):
            if filename is None:
                continue
            try:
                value = json.loads(read_bytes(filename, MAX_SOURCE))
            except (UnicodeError, ValueError) as exc:
                raise Problem("Portfolio " + field + " must be valid JSON.", 422, "INVALID_JSON") from exc
            if not isinstance(value, expected_type):
                kind = "array" if expected_type is list else "object"
                raise Problem("Portfolio " + field + " must be a JSON " + kind + ".", 422, "INVALID_JSON")
            body[field] = value
        result = ops.seed_portfolio(args.case, body)
    elif action == "portfolios":
        result = {"portfolios": ops.list_portfolios(args.case)}
    elif action == "portfolio-show":
        result = ops.portfolio(args.case, args.portfolio)
    elif action == "portfolio-export":
        return {"portfolioId": args.portfolio, "output": publish(args.output, ops.export_portfolio(args.case, args.portfolio))}
    elif action == "portfolio-selection":
        result = ops.select_portfolio(args.case, {"expectedVersion": args.expected_version,
            "portfolioId": args.portfolio, "alternativeId": args.alternative})
    elif action in ("portfolio-preview", "portfolio-save"):
        try:
            inputs = json.loads(read_bytes(args.inputs, MAX_SOURCE))
        except (UnicodeError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise Problem("Portfolio input must be a UTF-8 JSON object.", 422, "INVALID_JSON") from exc
        if action == "portfolio-preview":
            result = ops.preview_portfolio(args.case, {"expectedVersion": args.expected_version, "inputs": inputs})
        else:
            result = ops.command(args.case, {"expectedVersion": args.expected_version, "actor": args.actor,
                "requestId": args.request_id, "note": args.note, "action": "portfolio.save",
                "data": {"inputs": inputs, "expectedPreviewSha256": args.expected_preview_sha256}})
    elif action == "review":
        result = ops.review(args.case, args.review)
    elif action in ("create", "intake"):
        body = {"planId": args.plan, "selectedRevision": args.selected_revision,
                "expectedContentSha256": args.expected_content_sha256, "name": args.name,
                "calendarStart": args.calendar_start, "actor": args.actor, "requestId": args.request_id}
        if action == "create":
            result = ops.create({**body, "mode": args.mode})
        else:
            from operations_intake import import_source_intake
            result = import_source_intake(ops, read_bytes(args.file, MAX_SOURCE), body)
    elif action == "attach-dcat":
        data = {"filename": Path(args.file).name,
                "contentBase64": base64.b64encode(read_bytes(args.file, dcat_sources.MAX_SOURCE)).decode("ascii"),
                "expectedSha256": args.expected_sha256, "kind": "other", "mediaType": "application/gzip",
                "sourceUrl": args.source_url, "observedAt": args.observed_at}
        result = ops.command(args.case, {"expectedVersion": args.expected_version, "requestId": args.request_id,
            "actor": args.actor, "note": args.note, "action": dcat_sources.ACTION, "data": data})
    elif action in ("command", "attach"):
        if action == "attach":
            data = {"filename": Path(args.file).name, "contentBase64": base64.b64encode(read_bytes(args.file, MAX_SOURCE)).decode(),
                    "kind": args.kind, "mediaType": args.media_type, "sourceUrl": args.source_url, "observedAt": args.observed_at}
            verb = "source.add"
        else:
            try:
                data = json.loads(read_bytes(args.data))
            except (UnicodeError, ValueError) as exc:
                raise Problem("Action data must be a UTF-8 JSON object.", 422, "INVALID_JSON") from exc
            verb = args.action
        result = ops.command(args.case, {"expectedVersion": args.expected_version, "requestId": args.request_id,
                                       "actor": args.actor, "note": args.note, "action": verb, "data": data})
    elif action == "source":
        metadata, raw = ops.source(args.case, args.source)
        return {"source": metadata, "output": publish(args.output, raw)}
    elif action == "export":
        with workspace.mutex:
            current = ops.read(args.case)
            if current["program"]["version"] != args.expected_version:
                raise Problem("The operations case changed. Read it before exporting.", 409, "OPERATIONS_CONFLICT")
            raw = ops.export(args.case)
        return {"case": current["program"], "output": publish(args.output, raw)}
    elif action == "import":
        result = ops.import_bundle(read_bytes(args.file, dcat_sources.MAX_BUNDLE), args.name, args.request_id, args.actor)
    else:
        raise Problem("Unknown operations action.", 422, "UNKNOWN_COMMAND")
    if getattr(args, "output", None):
        return {"output": publish(args.output, (canonical(result) + "\n").encode())}
    return result

def store(handler):
    with handler.server.workspace.mutex:
        if not hasattr(handler.server, "operations"):
            handler.server.operations = Operations(handler.server.workspace)
        return handler.server.operations


def read(handler, parsed):
    if not parsed.path.startswith("/api/operations"):
        return False
    ops, query = store(handler), parse_qs(parsed.query)
    if supplier_statements_http(handler, parsed, ops, "GET"):
        return True
    if workbook_http.handle(handler, parsed, ops, "GET"):
        return True
    if risk_comparison.read_http(handler, parsed, ops):
        return True
    if forecast_comparison.read_http(handler, parsed, ops):
        return True

        safe_name = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9._ -]', "_", metadata["filename"])

        handler.send(200, ops.review(ident, action.split("/")[1]))

def decoded(raw, *, maximum=MAX_SOURCE):
    if not isinstance(raw, str):
        domain.fail("Attachment content must be base64 text.")
    if len(raw) > (maximum + 2) * 4 // 3 + 16:
        domain.fail("The original source attachment exceeds its selected native byte bound.", status=413)
    try:
        value = base64.b64decode(raw, validate=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise Problem("The original source encoding is invalid.", 422, "INVALID_SOURCE") from exc
    if not value or len(value) > maximum:
        domain.fail("Attach a nonempty original source within its selected native byte bound.", status=413)
    return value


def identifier(value, prefix=None):
    value = text(value, "Record identity", 100, True)
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,99}", value) or prefix and not value.startswith(prefix + "-"):
        domain.fail("Use the retained original record identity.")
    return value


def generated(prefix):
    return prefix + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex


class Operations:
    def __init__(self, workspace):
        self.workspace = workspace
        with workspace.mutex:
            workspace.db.executescript("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ops_metadata(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL);
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ops_programs(
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,plan_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plans(id),
                    plan_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,
                    name TEXT NOT NULL,mode TEXT NOT NULL,calendar_start TEXT,plan_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,origin_json TEXT NOT NULL);
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ops_records(
                    program_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ops_programs(id),kind TEXT NOT NULL,
                    id TEXT NOT NULL,state TEXT NOT NULL,body_json TEXT NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY(program_id,kind,id));
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ops_sources(
                    program_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ops_programs(id),id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL,content BLOB NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(program_id,id));
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ops_events(
                    program_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ops_programs(id),version INTEGER NOT NULL,

                    program_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ops_programs(id),id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    body_json TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(program_id,id));
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ops_forecasts(
                    program_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ops_programs(id),id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    body_json TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(program_id,id));
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ops_portfolios(
                    program_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ops_programs(id),id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    body_json TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(program_id,id));
            """)
            completion.install(workspace.db)
            installations.install(workspace.db)
            amendments.install(workspace.db)
            work_intake.install(workspace.db)
            expenses.install(workspace.db)
            row = workspace.db.execute("SELECT value FROM ops_metadata WHERE key='schema'").fetchone()
            if row and row[0] != SCHEMA:
                domain.fail("This workspace uses a newer operations schema.", "OPERATIONS_SCHEMA", 409)
            workspace.db.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO ops_metadata VALUES('schema',?)", (SCHEMA,))
            self.commercial = commercial_receivables.CommercialReceivables(self)
            self.commercial_changes = commercial_changes.CommercialChanges(self.commercial)
            self.expense_billing = expense_billing.ExpenseBilling(self)
            self.work_billing = work_billing.WorkBilling(self)
            self.billing_evidence = billing_evidence.BillingEvidence(self)

    @property
    def db(self):
        return self.workspace.db

    def _program(self, program_id):
        row = self.db.execute("SELECT id,plan_id,plan_revision,version,state,name,mode,calendar_start,plan_json,created_at,updated_at,origin_json FROM ops_programs WHERE id=?", (program_id,)).fetchone()
        if not row:
            domain.fail("Delivery operations case not found.", "OPERATIONS_NOT_FOUND", 404)
        program = {"id": row[0], "planId": row[1], "planRevision": row[2], "version": row[3], "state": row[4],
                   "name": row[5], "mode": row[6], "calendarStart": row[7], "createdAt": row[9],
                   "updatedAt": row[10], "origin": json.loads(row[11])}
        applied_version = amendments.last_applied_version(self, program_id)
        if applied_version:
            program["lastPlanAmendmentVersion"] = applied_version
        return program, json.loads(row[8])

    def _context(self, program_id):
        program, plan = self._program(program_id)
        records = {key: [] for key in domain.KINDS}
        for kind, raw in self.db.execute("SELECT kind,body_json FROM ops_records WHERE program_id=? ORDER BY kind,id", (program_id,)):
            records[kind].append(json.loads(raw))
        sources = {row["id"]: row for row in (json.loads(raw[0]) for raw in self.db.execute(
            "SELECT metadata_json FROM ops_sources WHERE program_id=? ORDER BY id", (program_id,)))}
        result = {"program": program, "plan": plan, "records": records, "sources": sources,
                  "completionPlans": completion.load_plans(self, program_id)}
        expense_records = expenses.load(self, program_id)
        if expenses.has_records(expense_records):
            result["expenseRecords"] = expense_records
        refs = installations.latest_refs(installations.load_heads(self, program_id))
        if refs:
            result["installationRefs"] = refs
        intake_refs = work_intake.refs(work_intake.load(self, program_id))
        if intake_refs:
            result["workIntakeRefs"] = intake_refs
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def _business(context):
        p = context["program"]
        result = {"program": {key: p[key] for key in ("id", "name", "mode", "calendarStart")},
                  "plan": context["plan"], "records": context["records"],
                  "sources": sorted(context["sources"].values(), key=lambda row: row["id"])}
        if context.get("completionPlans"):
            result["completionPlans"] = context["completionPlans"]
        if context.get("installationRefs"):
            result["installationRefs"] = context["installationRefs"]
        if context.get("workIntakeRefs"):
            result["workIntakeRefs"] = context["workIntakeRefs"]
        if expenses.has_records(expenses.retained(context)):
            result["expenseRecords"] = context["expenseRecords"]
        return result

    def _read(self, program_id):
        context = self._context(program_id)
        result = {**context, "sources": list(context["sources"].values()),
                  "report": domain.report(**context)}
        result["awardTerms"] = [award_terms.summary(row) for row in award_terms.heads(award_terms.records(self, program_id))]
        result["statementSetups"] = [statement_profiles.summary(row) for row in statement_profiles.records(self, program_id)]
        result["completion"] = completion.dashboard(context)
        result["expenseAttribution"] = expenses.dashboard(context)
        result["amendments"] = [amendments.summary(row, context, digest(self._business(context)))
                                 for row in amendments.heads(amendments.load(self, program_id))]
        cohort_history = self._cohort_history(program_id)
        result["installations"] = installations.latest_summaries(installations.load_heads(self, program_id))
        result["workIntakes"] = [work_intake.summary(row) for row in work_intake.heads(work_intake.load(self, program_id))]
        result["reviews"] = [{**{key: row[key] for key in ("id", "version", "createdAt", "actor", "note", "businessSha256")},
                              "purpose": row.get("purpose"),
                              **(supplier_statements.summary(row) if row.get("purpose") == supplier_statements.PURPOSE else {}),
                              **({"completionTranche": row["completion"]["clock"]["tranche"],
                                  "receiptId": row["completion"]["receipt"]["id"]} if row.get("purpose") == "TRANCHE_COMPLETION" else {}),
                              **(completion_corrections.summary(row) if row.get("purpose") == completion_corrections.PURPOSE else {}),
                              **(cohort.summary(row, context, cohort_history) if row.get("purpose") == "COHORT_EVALUATION" else {}),
                              **(implementation.summary(row, context) if row.get("purpose") == implementation.PURPOSE else {}),
                              **(engagements.summary(row) if row.get("purpose") == engagements.PURPOSE else {}),
                              **(engagements.receiving_summary(row) if row.get("purpose") == engagements.RECEIVING_PURPOSE else {})}
            for row in (json.loads(raw[0]) for raw in self.db.execute(
                "SELECT body_json FROM ops_reviews WHERE program_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC", (program_id,)))]
        latest = self.db.execute("SELECT current_revision FROM plans WHERE id=?", (result["program"]["planId"],)).fetchone()
        result["program"]["currentPlanRevision"] = latest[0]
        result["forecasts"] = [forecasts.summary(json.loads(row[0])) for row in self.db.execute(
            "SELECT body_json FROM ops_forecasts WHERE program_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC", (program_id,))]
        result["portfolios"] = [portfolios.summary(json.loads(row[0])) for row in self.db.execute(
            "SELECT body_json FROM ops_portfolios WHERE program_id=? ORDER BY rowid DESC", (program_id,))]
        return result

    def read(self, program_id):
        with self.workspace.mutex:
            return self._read(identifier(program_id, "operation"))

    def report(self, program_id):
        return self.read(program_id)["report"]

    def list(self, plan_id=None):
        with self.workspace.mutex:
            params = () if plan_id is None else (plan_id,)
            where = "" if plan_id is None else " WHERE plan_id=?"
            return [{"id": row[0], "planId": row[1], "planRevision": row[2], "version": row[3],
                     "state": row[4], "name": row[5], "mode": row[6], "updatedAt": row[7]}
                for row in self.db.execute("SELECT id,plan_id,plan_revision,version,state,name,mode,updated_at FROM ops_programs" + where + " ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id", params)]

    def _event(self, program_id, version, body, action, before=None, after=None, kind=None, record_id=None, source_change=None):
        event = {"version": version, "at": now(), "actor": body["actor"], "note": body.get("note", ""),
                 "requestId": body["requestId"], "action": action, "kind": kind, "recordId": record_id,
                 "before": before, "after": after}
        if source_change is not None:
            event["sourceChange"] = source_change
        event["sha256"] = digest(event)
        self.db.execute("INSERT INTO ops_events VALUES(?,?,?)", (program_id, version, canonical(event)))

    def create(self, body):
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            domain.fail("Provide a case creation object.")
        actor = text(body.get("actor"), "Recording operator", 300, True)
        name = text(body.get("name"), "Operations case name", 300, True)
        mode = domain.enum(body.get("mode"), ("OPERATIONS", "WALKTHROUGH"), "Case purpose")
        revision = domain.integer(body.get("selectedRevision"), "Saved plan revision", 1, 1000000)
        expected = domain.sha(body.get("expectedContentSha256"), "Reviewed plan content", False)
        anchor = domain.calendar(body.get("calendarStart"), "Operational calendar anchor", True)
        payload = {"domain": SCHEMA, "action": "create", "body": body}
        def action():
            plan = self.workspace._read(body["planId"], revision)
            if plan["contentSha256"] != expected:
                domain.fail("The selected saved plan differs from the reviewed source.", "PLAN_SOURCE_CONFLICT", 409)
            pid, stamp = generated("operation"), now()
            actual_anchor = anchor or plan["planning"].get("calendarStart")
            self.db.execute("INSERT INTO ops_programs VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (pid, plan["id"], revision, 1, "OPEN", name, mode, actual_anchor, canonical(plan), stamp, stamp, "{}"))
            self._event(pid, 1, {**body, "actor": actor, "note": "Opened from selected immutable planning revision"},
                        "create", after={"planId": plan["id"], "revision": revision, "contentSha256": expected,
                                         "sourceSha256": plan["source"]["sha256"], "mode": mode})
            return {"id": pid, "version": 1, "action": "create", "planId": plan["id"], "planRevision": revision}
        return self.workspace._transaction(body.get("requestId"), payload, action)

    def _record(self, program_id, kind, record_id):
        row = self.db.execute("SELECT body_json FROM ops_records WHERE program_id=? AND kind=? AND id=?",
                              (program_id, kind, record_id)).fetchone()
        if not row:
            domain.fail("The selected operations record is unavailable.", "RECORD_NOT_FOUND", 404)
        return json.loads(row[0])

    def _save(self, program_id, kind, row):
        self.db.execute("INSERT INTO ops_records VALUES(?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(program_id,kind,id) DO UPDATE SET state=excluded.state,body_json=excluded.body_json",
                        (program_id, kind, row["id"], row["state"], canonical(row)))

    def _source_add(self, program_id, data, *, _maximum=MAX_SOURCE, _dcat=False):
        if ((_dcat and _maximum != dcat_sources.MAX_SOURCE) or
                not _dcat and _maximum not in (MAX_SOURCE, buyer.MAX_CUSTOMER_USE_HANDOFF)):
            domain.fail("Use the supported original source bound.", status=413)
        content = decoded(data.get("contentBase64"), maximum=_maximum)
        if not _dcat and _maximum > MAX_SOURCE:
            if json.loads(content).get("schema") != buyer.CUSTOMER_USE_SCHEMA:
                domain.fail("The larger source bound is reserved for the native customer-use return.", status=413)
        name = text(data.get("filename"), "Original source filename", 240, True)
        if "/" in name or "\\" in name or name in (".", "..") or any(ord(char) < 32 for char in name):
            domain.fail("Use a plain original filename.")
        media = text(data.get("mediaType", "application/octet-stream"), "Source media type", 200, True)
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9!#$&^_.+-]+/[A-Za-z0-9!#$&^_.+-]+", media):
            domain.fail("Use a plain MIME media type.")
        retained = [{**json.loads(metadata), "bytes": size} for metadata, size in self.db.execute(
            "SELECT metadata_json,length(content) FROM ops_sources WHERE program_id=?", (program_id,))]
        transport = None
        if _dcat:
            if not name.lower().endswith(".ckanw"):
                domain.fail("Select the complete original .ckanw source filename.")
            expected = domain.sha(data.get("expectedSha256"), "Selected complete DCAT workspace SHA256", False)
            if hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() != expected:
                domain.fail("The selected DCAT workspace bytes differ.", "DCAT_SOURCE_CHANGED", 409)
            transport = dcat_sources.inspect(content)
        row = {"id": generated("source"), "filename": name, "mediaType": media,
               "kind": domain.enum(data.get("kind", "other"), ("invoice", "work", "grant", "payment", "deployment", "purchase", "other"), "Source kind"),
               "sourceUrl": domain.url(data.get("sourceUrl", ""), "Original source URL"),
               "observedAt": domain.timestamp(data.get("observedAt") or now(), "Source observation"),
               "bytes": len(content), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(), "createdAt": now()}
        if transport is not None:
            row["dcatWorkspace"] = transport
        dcat_sources.source_budget(retained + [row])
        self.db.execute("INSERT INTO ops_sources VALUES(?,?,?,?)", (program_id, row["id"], canonical(row), content))
        return row

    def preview_settlement(self, program_id, body):
        with self._snapshot():
            return settlement_sources.preview(self._context(identifier(program_id, "operation")), body)

    def preview_settlement_correction(self, program_id, body):

    def command(self, program_id, body, *, _within_transaction=False):
        program_id = identifier(program_id, "operation")
        if not isinstance(body, dict) or not isinstance(body.get("data", {}), dict):
            domain.fail("Use an operations command object.")
        expected = domain.integer(body.get("expectedVersion"), "Reviewed operations version", 1, 10000000)
        actor = text(body.get("actor"), "Recording operator", 300, True)
        note = text(body.get("note", ""), "Operation note", 12000)
        command = text(body.get("action"), "Operations action", 100, True)
        data = body.get("data", {})
        payload = {"domain": SCHEMA, "programId": program_id, "body": body}
        def action():
            context = self._context(program_id)
            program = context["program"]
            if program["version"] != expected:
                domain.fail("Another operations change was saved. Reopen the case and reconcile it.", "OPERATIONS_CONFLICT", 409)
            if program["state"] == "CLOSED" and command != "reopen":
                domain.fail("Reopen this closed review before recording new work.", "OPERATIONS_CLOSED", 409)
            next_version = expected + 1
            before, after, kind, record_id = None, None, None, None
            extra_receipt, source_change = {}, None
            if command == "source.add":
                after = self._source_add(program_id, data)
                kind, record_id = "source", after["id"]
            elif command == dcat_sources.ACTION:
                after = self._source_add(program_id, data, _maximum=dcat_sources.MAX_SOURCE, _dcat=True)
                kind, record_id = "source", after["id"]
            elif command == statement_profiles.ACTION:
                result = statement_profiles.save(self, context, data, actor, next_version, note)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                extra_receipt = {"statementSetup": result["statementSetup"]}
            elif command == "funding.save":
                result = funding.save(self, context, data, actor, next_version, note)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                extra_receipt = {"funding": result["funding"]}
            elif command == issuer_receiving.ACTION:
                if not _within_transaction:
                    domain.fail("Use the complete original message receiving action.")
                result = issuer_receiving.bind(self, context, data, actor, next_version, note)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                extra_receipt = {"correspondence": result["correspondence"]}
            elif command in award_terms.ACTIONS:
                if command == "award-terms.plan-bind" and not _within_transaction:
                    domain.fail("Use the complete reviewed terms-to-plan commissioning action.")
                result = (award_terms.save if command == "award-terms.save" else award_terms.bind)(
                    self, context, data, actor, next_version, note)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                source_change = result.get("sourceChange")
                extra_receipt = {key: value for key, value in result.items()
                                 if key not in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId", "sourceChange")}
            elif command == risks.ACTION:
                result = risks.save(self, context, data, actor, next_version, note)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                extra_receipt = {"reviewSha256": result["reviewSha256"], "riskRegister": result["riskRegister"]}
            elif command == "task-outcomes.save":
                result = task_outcomes.save(self, context, data, actor, next_version, note)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                extra_receipt = {"taskOutcomes": result["taskOutcomes"]}
            elif command == "statement.receive":
                context["statementSetups"] = [statement_profiles.summary(row) for row in statement_profiles.records(self, program_id)]
                context["cashCorrections"] = cash_accounts.statement_successors(self, context)
                result = statements.receive(self, context, data, actor, next_version)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                source_change = result.get("sourceChange")
                extra_receipt = {key: value for key, value in result.items()
                                 if key not in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId", "sourceChange")}
                if result["unchanged"]:
                    return {"id": program_id, "version": expected, "action": command, "kind": kind,
                            "recordId": record_id, **extra_receipt}
            elif command == "support.receive":
                result = support.receive(self, context, data, actor, next_version)
                source_change = result["sourceChange"]
                before, after, kind = result["before"], result["after"], "deployments"
                record_id = after["id"]
                extra_receipt = {"sourceIds": result["sourceIds"], "sourceSha256": result["sourceSha256"],
                                 "unchanged": result["unchanged"]}
                if result["unchanged"]:
                    return {"id": program_id, "version": expected, "action": command, "kind": kind,
                            "recordId": record_id, **extra_receipt}
            elif command == "buyer.receive":
                result = buyer.receive(self, context, data, actor, next_version)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                source_change = result.get("sourceChange")
                extra_receipt = {key: value for key, value in result.items()
                                 if key not in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId", "sourceChange")}
                if result["unchanged"]:
                    return {"id": program_id, "version": expected, "action": command, "kind": kind,
                            "recordId": record_id, **extra_receipt}
            elif command == supplier_statements.ACTION:
                result = supplier_statements.save(self, context, data, actor, next_version, note)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                extra_receipt = {"supplierStatement": result["supplierStatement"]}
            elif command in workbooks.ACTIONS:
                if command == "workbook.record-application" and not _within_transaction:

                extra_receipt = {"workbook": result["workbook"]}
            elif command in work_intake.ACTIONS:
                result = work_intake.command(self, context, command, data, actor, next_version, note)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                source_change = result.get("sourceChange")
                extra_receipt = {key: value for key, value in result.items()
                                 if key not in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId", "sourceChange")}
                if result["unchanged"]:
                    return {"id": program_id, "version": expected, "action": command, "kind": kind,
                            "recordId": record_id, **extra_receipt}
            elif command in ("settlement.receive", "settlement.correct"):
                handler = settlement_sources.receive if command == "settlement.receive" else settlement_sources.correct
                result = handler(self, context, data, actor, next_version, body.get("requestId"), note)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                source_change = result.get("sourceChange")
                extra_receipt = {key: value for key, value in result.items()
                                 if key not in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId", "sourceChange")}
                if result["unchanged"]:
                    return {"id": program_id, "version": expected, "action": command, "kind": kind,
                            "recordId": record_id, **extra_receipt}
            elif command in expenses.ACTIONS:
                result = (expenses.receive(self, context, data, actor, next_version)
                          if command == "expense.receive"
                          else expenses.attribution_command(self, context, command, data, actor, next_version, note))
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                source_change = result.get("sourceChange")
                extra_receipt = {key: value for key, value in result.items()
                                 if key not in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId", "sourceChange")}
                if result["unchanged"]:
                    return {"id": program_id, "version": expected, "action": command, "kind": kind,
                            "recordId": record_id, **extra_receipt}
            elif command == "implementation.prepare":
                result = implementation.prepare(self, context, data, actor, next_version)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                extra_receipt = {key: value for key, value in result.items()
                                 if key not in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId")}
            elif command == "cohort.prepare":
                result = cohort.prepare(self, context, data, actor, next_version, self._cohort_history(program_id))
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                extra_receipt = {key: value for key, value in result.items()
                                 if key not in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId")}
            elif command.startswith("completion."):
                if command == "completion.submit" and expenses.record_count(self, program_id) >= MAX_RECORDS:
                    domain.fail("This operations case has reached its retained-record bound.", status=413)
                result = completion.command(self, context, command, data, actor, next_version)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                extra_receipt = {key: value for key, value in result.items()
                                 if key not in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId")}
                if result["unchanged"]:
                    return {"id": program_id, "version": expected, "action": command, "kind": kind,
                            "recordId": record_id, **extra_receipt}
            elif command in ("installation.return", "installation.return-stage"):
                method = installation_returns.record if command == "installation.return" else installation_returns.stage
                result = method(self, context, data, actor, next_version, note)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                source_change = result.get("sourceChange")
                extra_receipt = {key: value for key, value in result.items()
                                 if key not in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId", "sourceChange")}
            elif command == "installation.save":
                result = installations.save(self, context, data, actor, next_version, note)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                extra_receipt = {key: value for key, value in result.items()
                                 if key not in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId")}
            elif command in amendments.ACTIONS:
                result = amendments.command(self, context, command, data, actor, next_version, note)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                extra_receipt = {key: value for key, value in result.items()
                                 if key not in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId")}
            elif command in ("engagement.prepare", "engagement.receiving"):
                if not note:
                    domain.fail("Record the review note for this contributor engagement edition.")
                result = (engagements.prepare if command == "engagement.prepare" else engagement_handover.receive)(
                    self, context, data, actor, next_version, note)
                before, after, kind, record_id = (result[key] for key in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId"))
                extra_receipt = {key: value for key, value in result.items()
                                 if key not in ("before", "after", "kind", "recordId")}
            elif command == "forecast.save":
                candidate = forecasts.preview(context, data.get("inputs"))
                if candidate["previewSha256"] != domain.sha(data.get("expectedPreviewSha256"), "Reviewed forecast", False):
                    domain.fail("The forecast inputs or source differ from the reviewed preview.", "FORECAST_PREVIEW_CONFLICT", 409)
                if self.db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ops_forecasts WHERE program_id=?", (program_id,)).fetchone()[0] >= forecasts.MAX_FORECASTS:
                    domain.fail("This case has reached its retained forecast bound.", status=413)
                record_id, kind = generated("forecast"), "forecast"
                row = {**candidate, "id": record_id, "version": next_version, "createdAt": now(),
                       "actor": actor, "note": note, "snapshot": context}
                row["sha256"] = digest(row)
                forecasts.validate_saved(row, context["plan"])
                self.db.execute("INSERT INTO ops_forecasts VALUES(?,?,?)", (program_id, record_id, canonical(row)))
                after = forecasts.summary(row)
            elif command == "portfolio.save":
                if not isinstance(data.get("inputs"), dict):
                    domain.fail("Use a portfolio input object.", "INVALID_PORTFOLIO")
                saved_forecast = self._portfolio_forecast(program_id, data.get("inputs", {}).get("forecastId"))
                context = portfolio_installations.capture(self, context, data["inputs"])
                candidate = portfolios.preview(context, saved_forecast, data.get("inputs"))
                if candidate["previewSha256"] != domain.sha(data.get("expectedPreviewSha256"), "Reviewed portfolio", False):
                    domain.fail("The portfolio inputs or source differ from the reviewed preview.", "PORTFOLIO_PREVIEW_CONFLICT", 409)
                if self.db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ops_portfolios WHERE program_id=?", (program_id,)).fetchone()[0] >= portfolios.MAX_PORTFOLIOS:
                    domain.fail("This case has reached its retained portfolio bound.", status=413)
                record_id, kind = generated("portfolio"), "portfolio"
                row = {**candidate, "id": record_id, "version": next_version, "createdAt": now(),
                       "actor": actor, "note": note, "snapshot": context, "baseForecastSnapshot": saved_forecast}
                row["sha256"] = digest(row)
                portfolios.validate_saved(row, context["plan"])
                self.db.execute("INSERT INTO ops_portfolios VALUES(?,?,?)", (program_id, record_id, canonical(row)))
                after = portfolios.summary(row)
            elif command in ("review", "close", "reopen"):
                if not note:
                    domain.fail("Retain the reason for this review, close or reopening.")
                if command == "review":
                    snapshot = self._business(context)
                    row = {"id": generated("review"), "version": next_version, "createdAt": now(),
                           "actor": actor, "note": note, "businessSha256": digest(snapshot),
                           "snapshot": snapshot, "report": domain.report(**context)}
                    self.db.execute("INSERT INTO ops_reviews VALUES(?,?,?)", (program_id, row["id"], canonical(row)))
                    after = {key: row[key] for key in ("id", "version", "businessSha256")}
                    record_id, kind = row["id"], "review"
                elif command == "close":
                    row = self.db.execute("SELECT body_json FROM ops_reviews WHERE program_id=? AND id=?", (program_id, data.get("reviewId"))).fetchone()
                    if not row:
                        domain.fail("Select the retained review being closed.")
                    review = json.loads(row[0])
                    if review["businessSha256"] != data.get("expectedReviewSha256") or review["businessSha256"] != digest(self._business(context)):
                        domain.fail("The case changed after that review. Review its current results before closing.", "REVIEW_CONFLICT", 409)
                    before, after = {"state": program["state"]}, {"state": "CLOSED", "reviewId": review["id"]}
                    self.db.execute("UPDATE ops_programs SET state='CLOSED' WHERE id=?", (program_id,))
                else:
                    if program["state"] != "CLOSED":
                        domain.fail("This operations case is already open.")
                    before, after = {"state": "CLOSED"}, {"state": "OPEN"}
                    self.db.execute("UPDATE ops_programs SET state='OPEN' WHERE id=?", (program_id,))
            else:
                bits = command.split(".")
                names = {"contributor": "contributors", "work": "work", "invoice": "invoices", "cash": "cash",
                         "award": "awards", "deployment": "deployments", "purchase": "purchases", "outcome": "outcomes"}
                if len(bits) != 2 or bits[0] not in names:
                    domain.fail("Unknown operations command.")
                kind, verb = names[bits[0]], bits[1]
                record_id = data.get("id")
                if record_id:
                    record_id = identifier(record_id, domain.PREFIX[kind])
                    before = self._record(program_id, kind, record_id)
                if verb in ("save", "record", "observe"):
                    valid = {"contributors": "save", "work": "save", "invoices": "save", "cash": "record",
                             "awards": "save", "deployments": "save", "purchases": "record", "outcomes": "save"}
                    if verb != valid[kind] and not (kind == "purchases" and verb == "observe" and before):
                        domain.fail("This record uses another lifecycle action.")
                    if not before and expenses.record_count(self, program_id) >= MAX_RECORDS:
                        domain.fail("This operations case has reached its retained-record bound.", status=413)
                    if kind == "purchases" and before and (verb != "observe" or not note):
                        domain.fail("Use purchase.observe with a reason to retain a later source observation.")
                    values = domain.prepare(kind, data, context, before)
                    record_id = record_id or generated(domain.PREFIX[kind])
                    after = {**values, "id": record_id, "version": next_version,
                             "createdAt": before["createdAt"] if before else now(), "updatedAt": now(),
                             "recordedBy": actor}
                else:
                    if not before or not note:
                        domain.fail("Select a retained record and record the reason for this transition.")
                    transitions = {
                        "work": {"submit": ({"LOGGED"}, "SUBMITTED"), "accept": ({"SUBMITTED"}, "ACCEPTED"),
                                 "reopen": ({"SUBMITTED", "ACCEPTED"}, "LOGGED"), "void": ({"LOGGED", "SUBMITTED", "ACCEPTED"}, "VOID")},
                        "invoices": {"review": ({"RECEIVED"}, "REVIEWED"), "dispute": ({"RECEIVED", "REVIEWED"}, "DISPUTED"),
                                     "reopen": ({"REVIEWED", "DISPUTED", "VOID"}, "RECEIVED"), "void": ({"RECEIVED", "REVIEWED", "DISPUTED"}, "VOID")},
                        "cash": {"void": ({"OBSERVED"}, "VOID")},
                        "purchases": {"void": ({"RECORDED"}, "VOID")}}
                    transition = transitions.get(kind, {}).get(verb)
                    if not transition or before["state"] not in transition[0]:
                        domain.fail("That action is not available from the retained record state.")
                    after = {**before, "state": transition[1], "version": next_version, "updatedAt": now(),
                             "reviewedBy": actor, "reviewNote": note}
                self._save(program_id, kind, after)
            self.db.execute("UPDATE ops_programs SET version=?,updated_at=? WHERE id=?", (next_version, now(), program_id))
            self._event(program_id, next_version, {**body, "actor": actor, "note": note}, command, before, after, kind, record_id,
                        source_change=source_change)
            if command == supplier_statements.ACTION or command in workbooks.ACTIONS or command in amendments.ACTIONS or command in award_terms.ACTIONS or command in ("funding.save", risks.ACTION, statement_profiles.ACTION):
                # Reject atomically if these complete decisions would make the
                # original case impossible to hand over through its native limit.
                self.export(program_id)
            return {"id": program_id, "version": next_version, "action": command, "kind": kind, "recordId": record_id,
                    **extra_receipt, **({"businessSha256": after["businessSha256"]} if command == "review" else {})}
        if _within_transaction:
            if not self.db.in_transaction:
                raise RuntimeError("Bulk operations require the original active workspace transaction.")
            return action()
        return self.workspace._transaction(body.get("requestId"), payload, action)

    def risk_request(self, program_id, body):
        """Reconcile one exact original command without admitting another write."""
        risks.obj(body, {"command"}, "Risk request lookup")
        command = risks.obj(body.get("command"), {"expectedVersion", "actor", "action", "data", "note", "requestId"},
                            "Original retained risk command")
        if command.get("action") != risks.ACTION:
            risks.fail("Select the original retained risk-register.save command.")
        domain.integer(command.get("expectedVersion"), "Original case version", 1, 10000000)
        actor = text(command.get("actor"), "Original recording operator", 300, True)
        text(command.get("note"), "Original review note", 12000, True)
        risks.obj(command.get("data"), {"document", "expectedPreviewSha256"}, "Original risk save data")
        request_id = short_id(command.get("requestId"), "Original request ID")
        with self._snapshot():
            self._program(identifier(program_id, "operation"))
            fingerprint = digest({"domain": SCHEMA, "programId": program_id, "body": command})
            row = self.db.execute("SELECT fingerprint,result_json FROM requests WHERE request_id=?", (request_id,)).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                return {"found": False, "requestId": request_id}
            if row[0] != fingerprint:
                raise Problem("This request ID already belongs to a different action.", 409, "REQUEST_CONFLICT")
            result = json.loads(row[1])
            event_row = self.db.execute("SELECT body_json FROM ops_events WHERE program_id=? AND version=?",
                                        (program_id, result.get("version"))).fetchone()
            if event_row is None:
                risks.fail("The accepted risk request has no matching case event.", "RISK_REQUEST_CHANGED", 409)
            event = json.loads(event_row[0])
            review = risks.raw_review(self, program_id, result.get("recordId"))
            if (result.get("id") != program_id or result.get("action") != risks.ACTION or result.get("kind") != "review"
                    or result.get("reviewSha256") != review["sha256"] or result.get("riskRegister") != risks.summary(review)
                    or event.get("action") != risks.ACTION or event.get("requestId") != request_id
                    or event.get("recordId") != review["id"] or event.get("after") != risks.summary(review)
                    or event.get("actor") != actor or event.get("version") != command["expectedVersion"] + 1
                    or digest({k: v for k, v in event.items() if k != "sha256"}) != event.get("sha256")):
                risks.fail("The accepted original risk request differs from its case history.", "RISK_REQUEST_CHANGED", 409)
            return {"found": True, "requestId": request_id, "fingerprint": row[0], "result": result}

    def export_risk_comparison(self, program_id, selection, expected_comparison_sha256, *,
                               kind="export.zip", expected_version=None):
        with self._snapshot():

            value = risk_comparison.compare(self, context, selection)["comparison"]
            risk_comparison.require_digest(value, expected_comparison_sha256)
            if kind == "export.zip":

                    raise Problem("Reopen the current case before exporting its complete comparison.", 409, "OPERATIONS_CONFLICT")
                return self.export(program_id, risk_comparison_selection=selection)
            if expected_version is not None:
                raise Problem("The case version condition is only available for the complete ZIP.", 422, "INVALID_RISK_COMPARISON")
            return risk_comparison.export_file(value, kind)

    def implementation_original(self, program_id, source_id, sha256):
        domain.sha(sha256, "Original implementation file SHA-256", False)
        metadata, raw = self.source(program_id, source_id)
        originals = implementation.original_files(raw)
        if sha256 not in originals:
            implementation.fail("This file is not in the selected original implementation.", "IMPLEMENTATION_FILE_NOT_FOUND", 404)
        _, state, _ = implementation.original_state(raw)
        material = next((row for row in state.get("materials", []) if row.get("sha256") == sha256), None)
        return {"filename": material["name"] if material else "original-" + sha256,
                "sha256": sha256, "bytes": len(originals[sha256]), "sourceId": metadata["id"]}, originals[sha256]
